Dear Assistant Administrator Escobari,
Thanks again for taking the time to meet this week. We hope you and Alex found the meeting as instructive as we did.
As discussed, I wanted share our latest Transparency Report on Community Standards Enforcement. Pedro mentioned it during our discussion and I thought it might pr

Sandy
